text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It is 1st place. I was able to
secure the victory, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You listened to my opinions
and adjusted the plan over and over again...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: They accommodated me not only with training methods, but also with locations and times that were convenient for me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Without your thorough, attentive guidance,
this victory would not have been possible."
choice_data_list: That was a magnificent run, you know.
This is just a stepping stone!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I take pride in knowing that I ran
just as I had envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
With you, I can reach even greater heights.
I am certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To even greater heights...
Let us climb together, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we are still midway through our journey.
The end of the road is still far off... I know that well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, where shall we begin?
choice_data_list: First, shall we do a review of today?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, as expected of you, Trainer.
Not letting your guard down for a single moment.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Having someone like you to guide me is truly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to continuing to work with you,
Trainer.
